items.headline: 76ers' Ariel Hukporti Suffers Season-Ending Achilles Tear
items.summary: Philadelphia 76ers center Ariel Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, according to ESPN's Shams Charania. The injury occurred during Philadelphia's preseason opener against the New York Knicks, just five minutes into the 24-year-old big man's Sixers debut. Tests confirmed the tear, delivering a major blow to the team's frontcourt depth.

items.headline: NBA Experiments with Smart Basketballs and Official Wearables
items.summary: The NBA is testing new technology in select preseason games, including smart basketballs with Bluetooth sensors for data collection and wrist wearables for officials to communicate with the replay center. While the smart ball data is for research only and won't affect in-game calls, the wearables went through a successful Summer League pilot program.

items.headline: Warriors Dominate Lakers in Preseason Rout
items.summary: The Golden State Warriors cruised to a decisive 124-98 victory over the Los Angeles Lakers in preseason action. Golden State shot an impressive 51% from the field and 42% from beyond the arc, while also outrebounding the Lakers 44-35 and dishing out 32 assists. Draymond Green led the Warriors with eight assists.

items.headline: Pelicans Mount Comeback to Defeat Thunder
items.summary: The New Orleans Pelicans overcame a 24-point deficit to beat the Oklahoma City Thunder 116-110 in a thrilling preseason opener at the BOK Center. The Pelicans dominated the second half, outscoring the Thunder 38-26 in the third quarter and 26-17 in the fourth. Bennedict Mathurin was a key contributor for New Orleans, while rookies Aday Mara and Bennett Stirtz showed promise for OKC.

items.headline: Warriors Face Blazers in Portland
items.summary: The Golden State Warriors, coming off a win last night, travel to Portland to face the Trail Blazers at Moda Center. This marks the Blazers' preseason opener, with Damian Lillard expected to make his return after missing last season due to an Achilles injury. The game tips off at 10:00 PM ET on NBA TV.

items.headline: Timberwolves vs. Pacers
items.summary: The Minnesota Timberwolves are set to clash with the Indiana Pacers in a preseason matchup. The Pacers are favored in this contest, especially with Tyrese Haliburton returning fully healthy.

items.headline: Suns Take on Bulls
items.summary: The Phoenix Suns will face the Chicago Bulls in a preseason game tonight. The Suns are predicted to win this matchup.

items.headline: Bucks Battle Thunder
items.summary: The Milwaukee Bucks are scheduled to play the Oklahoma City Thunder tonight. The Bucks are favored to secure a victory in this preseason encounter.

items.headline: Magic Host Grizzlies
items.summary: The Orlando Magic will host the Memphis Grizzlies for a preseason game. The Magic are anticipated to win, leveraging their size advantage with players like Paolo Banchero and Franz Wagner.

items.headline: Teams Continue Preseason Roster Adjustments
items.summary: As the regular season approaches, teams are trimming their training camp rosters. The Utah Jazz waived guard Terrell Brown Jr., who is expected to join the Salt Lake City Stars. The Orlando Magic signed and waived Johnell Davis to retain his G League rights, while the Oklahoma City Thunder released Robert McCray V from his Exhibit 10 contract.
